articles.summary: Introduces Second Quarter Outlook with Improved Sequential Sales Trend IRVINE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jun. 4, 2025-- Tilly’s, Inc. (NYSE: TLYS, the "Company") today announced financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2025 ended May 3, 2025 .
